description: Arabic is the fallback donor for en, pl, ru and fr requests. Arabic is the only one of the seven languages with ZERO and TWO categories, so a fallback that lands on CARDINALITY_ZERO or CARDINALITY_TWO is proof positive that evaluation used the donor's rules. The catalog also carries an RTL template with a caller-supplied placeholder, because interpolateTemplate decides bidi isolation from the same `locale` argument it uses for plural selection (shouldApplyBidiIsolation(locale, bidiIsolation) at DefaultStrings.java:1367), i.e. from the donor.
